_comment: PAPER DESIGN — docs/rakshasa-design-proposal.md. Not in the world. Numbers here are the proposal's starting block (§2, §5), not a tuned build. Spec format: an actor document with the same system.props keys a real CSB actor uses, plus mindscape_* modelling fields (ruleset Part 8).
name: Rakshasa

props._defense_comment: CSB derives these (DEX die + def_mod / INS die + mdef_mod) and stores the result; the loader reads the STORED value. Stating them here is the same discipline the design doc demands of the built actor — re-stamp, never leave a donor's numbers on disk.
props._affinity_comment: VU light · RS dark · RS poison · NA rest (§2). Keys: 1 physical 2 air 3 bolt 4 dark 5 earth 6 fire 7 ice 8 light 9 poison.
props._ef_comment: All lanes start neutral. Adaptive Defense is the only thing that moves them — a static profile would fight the dynamic one (§2).

props._comment: Live: one apply_ae row over a 4-name pool with ae_pool_skip_existing, so it never redraws the form it holds. Costs the activation — that is why the strikes are double potency.
200% vs a target IN Crisis, via the Execute reaction entry (Kirin's Horn Rush pattern). ~51 raw normally, ~102 into Crisis.
200% vs a target NOT in Crisis. The DEF debuff rider is NOT modelled — flagged in the run notes.
Bleed rider NOT modelled (no DoT layer offline) — reads slightly LOW.
Overflow rolls ONE accuracy check live; the model rolls per target, so its variance is understated (the mean is not).
Registry entry in lib/reactions.js. 5-slot LRU window, curve 25/40/60/80, eviction stops at Crisis (Ten Thousand Arms).
